settings.title: GlobalLink translation
settings.notEnabled: GlobalLink translation is not enabled on this site, or you do not hold the "adminGlobalLinkTranslation" permission here. Enable the module on the site in Site settings > Modules, or ask a site administrator.

loadError.title: The settings could not be loaded
loadError.message: Check that you are still signed in, then retry.

settings.savedWithError: Settings saved, but GlobalLink refused them: see the message on the page
settings.saveFailed: The settings could not be saved
settings.refreshFailed: GlobalLink languages could not be reloaded

banner.connector: GlobalLink has no connector named "{{connector}}". Available: {{available}}. Translation requests stay switched off until the name is fixed and saved.
banner.connection: Check the username, password, API URL and connector name.

activated.label: Send translation requests to GlobalLink
activated.helper: When off, editors cannot request translations on this site and nothing is sent to GlobalLink.

username.label: Username
username.helper: A technical GlobalLink user: translations.com shows it as the submitter of every request.

password.label: Password
password.helperStored: A password is stored. Leave empty to keep it, or type a new one.

url.label: GlobalLink API URL
url.helper: Given by translations.com, for example https://connect.translations.com/api/v2/

submissionPrefix.label: Request name prefix
submissionPrefix.helper: A request without a name is called "<prefix> - <page name>".

fileFormat.label: File format
fileFormat.helper: File format of the connector, given by translations.com (usually Jahia_XML).

fileLocation.label: Documents location
fileLocation.helper: Server folder for the files sent to and received from GlobalLink. Leave empty for the default, <server temp folder>/gbl.

interval.label: Check interval (minutes)
interval.helper: How often Jahia sends new requests and retrieves translations.

errors.interval: A whole number of minutes, 1 or more
errors.components: Select at least one content type
errors.summary: Some settings are missing or invalid: see the fields marked in red

languages.title: Languages
languages.noDirection: The connector declares no language direction.
languages.mappingHelp: Choose the GlobalLink locale of each site language. A language left without a locale is not offered for translation.
languages.unavailable: Save valid connection settings with requests switched on: the GlobalLink languages of the connector then show here.

components.title: Content types to translate
components.help: Only these content types are sent to GlobalLink. The lists show types with at least one translatable text property.

requests.title: Translation requests
requests.loadError: The requests could not be loaded

empty.title: No translation request yet
empty.message: Editors request a translation from the menu of a page in jContent.

clean.label: Delete requests created more than
clean.confirmMessage: Requests to delete: {{value}}, created more than {{days}} days ago. They are deleted from Jahia, whatever their status. Translations already applied to the content stay. This cannot be undone.
clean.failed: The requests could not be deleted
